title: Order VI Rule 17 CPC — Amendment of pleadings

content.overview: Amendments that decide the real controversy are allowed. After trial starts, due-diligence must be shown.
content.study: Do not use amendment to displace limitation or to substitute a new cause after the clock has run, except where doctrine allows. Costs usually follow a late amendment.
